$description: Golden-set regression for chart-chat topic routing. Each case is a user question; after ChartTopicRouter.Rerank runs over the mock passage pool, the 'expected_top_signature_prefix' list names the signature prefixes that MUST appear in the top `top_k` passages. If rerank regresses (new keyword list breaks old routing, or a passage starts winning it shouldn't), these tests fail loudly.
$how_to_add_a_case: 1. Write the user question the way a real chart-chat user would ask it. 2. Name the houses + planets classical Jyotish reads for that topic. 3. Pick 1-3 signature prefixes that MUST float to the top after rerank. 4. Set top_k to how many passages you expect the LLM to see. 5. Run the tests; iterate the keyword list in ChartTopicRouter.cs until this passes AND the older cases still pass.

cases.notes: Classical Manglik = Mars in 1/2/4/7/8/12 from Lagna. Should pull Mars-in-house passages first, not marriage/venus ones.

cases.query: does my chart have mangal dosha
cases.notes: Alternative spelling (Mangal Dosha / Kuja Dosha) should route to the same passages.

cases.query: what does my chart say about money and investing?
cases.notes: Wealth = 2nd + 11th houses; Jupiter/Venus/Mercury as karakas. At least one of these should top the rerank.

cases.query: am I in the right career?
cases.notes: Career = 10th/6th, Sun/Saturn/Mercury karakas. Top-6 reflects real passage slice; uniform mock pool ties force widening to cover all three karakas.

cases.query: when will I get married and who will my partner be?
cases.notes: Partnership = 7th, 5th; Venus/Jupiter karakas. Rerank should surface Venus-in-house and Jupiter-in-house passages.

cases.query: what does my chart say about my health?
cases.notes: 1st/6th/8th houses (3 active) × 3 karakas = 9 score-5 passages; top_k widened so all three karakas are represented in the uniform mock. In production retrieval the slice is narrower but also topic-matched per-user chart so the same invariant — 'each karaka is surfaced somewhere' — holds.

9th/12th houses; Jupiter (dharma) and Ketu (moksha) are the karakas. Requires BOTH father/dharma rule AND moksha rule to fire — the keyword 'spiritual path' in the moksha rule was added to close this gap after the scaffold first flagged it.

cases.query: I feel like I'm going through a huge transformation, what does my chart show?
cases.notes: 8th house; Saturn/Mars/Ketu carry the crisis-and-rebirth texture.

cases.query: what does my chart say about my family and home?
cases.notes: 4th house; Moon is the primary karaka.

cases.query: who am I according to my chart?

cases.notes: Generic ask with no keywords hits NO rule. Rerank should preserve original order (empty expected list = no assertion on top).
